caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular composition filled with a geometric pattern, predominantly using two colors: a muted blue and an off-white or light beige. The left side features a large circular motif with stepped edges and symmetrical, block-like extensions, primarily in off-white with blue background. Immediately above and to the right of this motif are five horizontal rows of elongated, blue-bordered, off-white geometric shapes resembling stylized elongated diamonds or bars, all aligned vertically. Moving further to the right, the central and upper-right sections of the rectangle are filled with a repeating pattern of blue, roughly diamond-shaped forms arranged in vertical columns, with small off-white spaces separating them, creating a grid-like effect. The lower-right section features vertical blue stripes of varying thickness with small, off-white gaps interspersed, alongside some smaller blue shapes resembling dots. The entire patterned area is set against a plain off-white background. Near the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a signature in cursive script.
title: Old Colonial Handwoven Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
